  PROBLEM: PR_NUMBER is interpolated into the artifact path without sanitization, so `../` sequences can escape `.ai/review_runtime/`.

  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: ROUND_NUMBER_BASE / AUTOFIX_ITERATION are read into the round directory name without a hard validation boundary.
  WHY: A malformed round component can be folded into `round-${CURRENT_ROUND}` and is only weakly guarded before path construction.
- scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh:84-97 | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: `validate_repo_relative_path_syntax` rejects any path containing `..` anywhere in the string.
  WHY: Legitimate filenames with consecutive dots are incorrectly treated as traversal attempts and get demoted.
- scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh:102-112,647 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The bash truthiness check does not trim whitespace, so schema-enabled parsing can disagree with the verifier for padded env values.
  WHY: Whitespace-padded `CONSOLIDATOR_REJECT_SCHEMA_ENABLED` values can be interpreted inconsistently across stages.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:46,381-384 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The Python verifier strips whitespace from `SCHEMA_ENABLED` while the bash side does not.
  WHY: The two stages can disagree on whether schema validation is enabled for the same input.
- scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh:114-128 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `extract_evidence_value` preserves trailing whitespace in extracted values.
  WHY: A path like `src/module.py  ` will not match the exact patch key later and valid already-fixed rejections can be reversed.
- scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh:192-225 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The parser enforces an undocumented 500-character limit on `quote:` lines in `EVIDENCE_SPEC_QUOTE` blocks.
  WHY: A legitimate long spec citation gets demoted to `unclassified` even though the quote is valid.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:183-195 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Deletion-only diffs are not recorded because `+++ /dev/null` clears `current_path`.
  WHY: An already-fixed rejection citing a deleted file is treated as if the PR diff does not touch the file.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:183-188,195 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: A hunk with zero added lines produces `hunk_end < hunk_start`, which the already-fixed verifier skips.
  WHY: Context-only/removal-only hunks become invisible, so matching evidence can be missed.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:129-152 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `extract_files_touched` only recognizes exact `files_touched:` / `- files_touched:` headers and exact `- path` entries.
  WHY: Slightly different formatting makes the verifier return `None` and fall back to `inconclusive`.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:200-220,413-416 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: When any block is mutated, `render_blocks` rewrites every block using its own serialization rules instead of preserving the original text.
  WHY: Non-mutated blocks can change formatting, ordering, or field shape and downstream consumers may not tolerate the rewrite.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:413-414 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The verifier overwrites `review_issues.txt` in place without creating a backup copy.
  WHY: A crash, serialization bug, or disk-full condition during the write can lose the only copy of the parser output for the run.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:215-236 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `tests/test_review_reject_verify.py` is missing from the mark-stable workflow allowlist.
  WHY: The release-gate workflow never executes the reject-verifier tests, so typed rejection regressions can ship undetected.
- scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh:643-645 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `CONSOLIDATOR_REJECT_TYPED` is logged for every non-actionable block with a rejection kind, even when schema validation is disabled.
  WHY: Schema-off runs still emit typed-rejection diagnostics, creating noisy output that can look like schema enforcement is active.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:391-399 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The verifier has no positive success marker for a clean run.
  WHY: Operators can only infer success from the absence of error markers.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:391-401 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new verifier log prefixes are not registered in the stable log prefix registry.
  WHY: Workflow log analysis tooling will not discover or report on these markers until they are added to the registry.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:267-279 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `REVERSAL_REASON` is truncated through `squish(limit=160)` in logs.
  WHY: Long reversal explanations lose the file/line detail needed for operators to identify the exact issue from logs.
